newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nedlloyd Q1 net loss trebles, firm sees 97 profit.
newsitem.headline: Nedlloyd Q1 net loss trebles, firm sees 97 profit.

text.p: Dutch shipping and road transport group Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV said on Wednesday first quarter loss trebled but forecast a profit on ordinary activities for the full year.

Nedlloyd announced first quarter losses on ordinary activities of 45 million guilders ($23.9 million), up from 15 million in the first quarter of 1996. The year earlier figure included a 30 million guilder capital gain on the sale of vessels, without which losses would have been unchanged.

At the operating level, excluding the impact of its P&O Nedlloyd venture with Britain's Peninsular and Oriental Steam Navigation Co, the group made a profit of 13 million guilders, up from 10 million. Net turnover moved ahead to 851 million guilders from 804 million.

Nedlloyd, which had a 49 million guilder net attributable profit in 1996, said it was too early to give a specific projection for 1997 because of uncertainties in container shipping, particularly regarding rate developments.
"Based on our current knowledge, however, we expect Nedlloyd as a whole to achieve a positive result on ordinary activities in 1997," the company said in a statement with the results.
Nedlloyd added it expected its P&O Nedlloyd venture to contribute postively during 1997.
Nedlloyd's share in the P&O Nedlloyd first quarter loss was 38 million guilders, compared to a three million loss in its Ocean Shipping division a year earlier.
It said the merger of its container business with P&O was ahead of schedule and would lead to greater synergy savings than the two parent companies had originally forecast.

"Container revenue rates have continued to reduce as anticipated in Q1 1997 but are starting to show signs of stability and the overall outlok is beginning to look more positive," Nedlloyd said, adding that savings for P&O Nedlloyd would be achieved in the fourth quarter.

Analysts had expected Koninklijke Nedlloyd Groep NV to post a net result before extraordinary items between a nine million guilder profit and a 44 million guilder loss, with consensus at a loss of 17 million guilders. ($ = 1.885 Dutch Guilders)
